## File: facebookresearch_cutler/cutler/evaluation/coco_evaluation.py

Prompts

```
['run COCOEvaluator on a dataset to compute AP, AR, and keypoint metrics for object detection results', 'create a COCOEvaluator instance with custom max_dets_per_image and fast implementation settings', 'test instances_to_coco_json to convert detectron2 Instances objects into COCO-format JSON for evaluation', 'run _evaluate_box_proposals to compute recall and average recall metrics for detection proposals', 'review COCOevalMaxDets class to customize COCO evaluation with a non-default max detections per image limit']
```

Usage

```
{'run_COCOEvaluator': 'run COCOEvaluator on a dataset to compute AP, AR, and keypoint metrics for object detection results', 'create_COCOEvaluator': 'create a COCOEvaluator instance with custom max_dets_per_image and fast implementation settings', 'test_instances_to_coco_json': 'test instances_to_coco_json to convert detectron2 Instances objects into COCO-format JSON for evaluation', 'run_evaluate_box_proposals': 'run _evaluate_box_proposals to compute recall and average recall metrics for detection proposals', 'review_COCOevalMaxDets': 'review COCOevalMaxDets class to customize COCO evaluation with a non-default max detections per image limit'}
```
